title: Maximum Mogging
author: Jesse A.
desc: The purpose of this program is to maximize hypertrophy in the chest, lats, and arms while managing fatigue and protecting the lower back. It uses strict, controlled movements, lengthened-range loading, and RPE-guided intensity to ensure optimal muscle stimulus, balanced volume, and efficient recovery.
